services.name: Class & Camp Sign Up
services.desc: We are just the place if you are looking for something fun and creative for your child to do after school or during the summer. Our art camps and classes offer age-appropriate projects and a fun, experimental place to create. The kids will be led in projects using a variety of mediums and techniques and leave with many masterpieces to call their own. Coming soon: Halloween Houses & SPS No School Days. CLASSES & WORKSHOPS are not 100% refundable or transferable so make sure you have your dates right and look at our protocol and policy section before signing up! Located in the heart of Seattle’s Magnolia neighborhood since 2017!3315 West McGraw Street - Seattle, WA 98199 -

blurb: Whether you're looking to take a class for yourself, art enrichment for your kids, birthday parties, art parties, any party, sell and showcase your goods...goodness, the list goes on! Please come to us with your ideas, your art or just a willingness to create.
